In your sealed deck tournament, you'll find the Z-95 is immune to Tallon Rolls (that interrupt cannot target an independent starship). It has no hyperdrive, but it can be carried on a [[Corellian Corvette]] like a vehicle. After the sealed deck event, you'll want lots of these babies in your cloud decks. At non-unique cloud sectors, they hold their own against the Obsidian TIEs from Cloud City. Combos: Z-95 + [[Corellian Corvette]]: At last, carry a starfighter on a Light Side capital ship.
